subject: Scheduling: Veridian Health SOC 2 / security architecture deep-dive

Subject: SOC 2 architecture review — scheduling request

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the demo last week — the Veridian platform team is ready to move into a focused security architecture review so our compliance team can validate SOC 2 evidence and signaling. We'd like to cover:
- Encryption at-rest and in-transit (KMS options)
- Audit logging detail and retention
- SSO / IdP integration (SAML / OIDC)
- Evidence we can pull for SOC 2 scope (SSP, logs, access reviews)

Can we book a 60–90 minute deep-dive with your architecture/security team next week? Preferably Aug 4–6 (US Eastern). I'll include our infrastructure lead if possible.

Attaching a short checklist of items our audit team expects (SOC2-evidence-checklist.xlsx).

2) Wed Aug 5, 10:00–11:30 AM ET
3) Thu Aug 6, 2:00–3:30 PM ET

- 10 min: introductions & scope confirmation
- 30 min: architecture walkthrough (networking, kms, telemetry)
